risks.title: Cloud Provider Multi-AZ Failure & Network Partition
risks.mitigating_control: Automated Patroni DCS quorum failover to secondary AZ with sync replication (RTO < 5m, RPO = 0s).

risks.title: Silent Database Data Corruption or Uncommitted WAL Gap
risks.mitigating_control: pg_checksums enabled on all blocks; continuous pgBackRest PITR verification with sha256 checksums.

risks.title: KMS Key Revocation / Secret Vault Unavailability During Restore
risks.mitigating_control: Multi-region replicated Vault clusters & backup key escrow with split-key Shamir recovery protocol.

risks.title: Runbook Drift & Operational Human Error during Outage
risks.mitigating_control: 100% automated CI/CD documentation drift detection and self-executing runbook automation scripts.

risks.title: Non-compliant Backup Retention & Missing Audit Trail
risks.mitigating_control: Automated WORM storage compliance policies, daily audit package generation, and immutable log signing.
